items.html: And know that all this is only the Achoraim of BaN and the Achoraim of MaH, both in ZA and in the Nukva; therefore they were still back to back, for both of them were the aspect of Achor. And afterward, they return and take the Panim of BaN and the Panim of MaH, both in ZA and in the Nukva, and then they return face to face. Understand this key greatly. However, while ZA takes the Panim, and Rachel still has only Achoraim, then it is called "Panim and Achor." Understand this. And after he drew the Panim into Rachel, then both of them are face to face.
